name: qlrisk_price_fx_barrier_option
title: Price a FXBarrierOption
description:
Price one FX Barrier Option (qlrisk FXBarrierOption).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, barrier_type=UpOut, rebate=0, option_type=call (call/put), strike, pair, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, spot, domestic_curve, foreign_curve, foreign_rate_pct, position.
Example: {"maturity": "1Y", "notional": 1000000} gives NPV 1,945.41 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
